title: The brain’s EM field is the substrate of consciousness

statements.text: Consciousness is physically integrated and causally active information encoded in the brain's global electromagnetic field. It is encoded by the energy of the fields made by moving charges, not by the matter of the brain.

sources.quote: consciousness is physically integrated, and causally active, information encoded in the brain’s global electromagnetic (EM) field
claims that the brain’s EM field is the physical substrate of consciousness
